name: bk-lite-dev
install:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Idempotent Cloud Agent dependency install. Must exit. Do not start servers here.
set -euo pipefail

if [ ! -d server ] || [ ! -d web ]; then
  echo "[install] run from the repository root" >&2
  exit 1
fi

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
# /usr/bin/c++ is clang and does not see GCC 13's libstdc++. Python extension
# builds (ujson, psycopg2) must use gcc/g++.
export CC=gcc
export CXX=g++

echo "[install] system packages"
sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential \
  ca-certificates \
  curl \
  default-jre-headless \
  libpq-dev \
  pkg-config \
  postgresql \
  postgresql-contrib \
  unixodbc-dev \
  xz-utils

echo "[install] uv"
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
fi
sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv
sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx

echo "[install] node 24"
export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"
nvm install 24
nvm alias default 24
nvm use 24

NODE_BIN="$(nvm which current)"
NODE_DIR="$(dirname "${NODE_BIN}")"
sudo ln -sfn "${NODE_BIN}" /usr/local/bin/node
sudo ln -sfn "${NODE_DIR}/npm" /usr/local/bin/npm
sudo ln -sfn "${NODE_DIR}/npx" /usr/local/bin/npx
sudo ln -sfn "${NODE_DIR}/corepack" /usr/local/bin/corepack
export PATH="${NODE_DIR}:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"

MARKER="# bklite-cloud-node24"
if ! grep -q "${MARKER}" "${HOME}/.bashrc"; then
  cat >> "${HOME}/.bashrc" <<'EOF'
# bklite-cloud-node24
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
if [ -d "$NVM_DIR/versions/node" ]; then
  _bklite_node24=$(ls -d "$NVM_DIR/versions/node"/v24.* 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1 || true)
  if [ -n "${_bklite_node24:-}" ]; then
    PATH="$_bklite_node24/bin:$PATH"
    export PATH
  fi
fi
unset _bklite_node24
EOF
fi

echo "[install] pnpm 11.20.0"
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.20.0 --activate
if [ -x "${NODE_DIR}/pnpm" ]; then
  sudo ln -sfn "${NODE_DIR}/pnpm" /usr/local/bin/pnpm
fi
hash -r

echo "[install] python 3.12"
uv python install 3.12

echo "[install] server dependencies"
( cd server && uv sync --all-groups --all-extras --python 3.12 )
if [ ! -f server/.env ]; then
  printf '%s\n' \
    'DEBUG=True' \
    'SECRET_KEY=cursor-cloud-dev' \
    'DB_ENGINE=postgresql' \
    'DB_NAME=bklite' \
    'DB_USER=bklite' \
    'DB_PASSWORD=bklite' \
    'DB_HOST=127.0.0.1' \
    'DB_PORT=5432' \
    'ENABLE_CELERY=true' \
    'IS_LOCAL_RPC=1' \
    'MINIO_ENDPOINT=127.0.0.1:9000' \
    'MINIO_ACCESS_KEY=dev' \
    'MINIO_SECRET_KEY=dev' \
    'MINIO_USE_HTTPS=false' \
    > server/.env
fi

echo "[install] web dependencies"
( cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile )
if [ ! -f web/.env.local ]; then
  printf '%s\n' \
    'NEXTAUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000' \
    'NEXTAUTH_SECRET=cursor-cloud-dev' \
    'NEXTAPI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8011' \
    'NEXT_PUBLIC_IS_DEMO_ENV=false' \
    > web/.env.local
fi

echo "[install] stargazer dependencies"
( cd agents/stargazer && uv sync --all-groups --all-extras --python 3.12 )

echo "[install] webchat dependencies"
( cd webchat && npm ci )

echo "[install] done"
node -v
pnpm -v
uv --version
start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Per-boot services. Safe to rerun. Postgres data and dev servers do not survive a snapshot.
set -euo pipefail

if [ ! -d server ] || [ ! -d web ]; then
  echo "[start] run from the repository root" >&2
  exit 1
fi
ROOT="$(pwd)"
export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"
nvm use 24
export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"

echo "[start] postgresql"
if ! pg_isready -q; then
  sudo service postgresql start || sudo pg_ctlcluster "$(pg_lsclusters -h | awk 'NR==1 {print $1, $2}')" start
fi
ready=0
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if pg_isready -q; then
    ready=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "${ready}" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "[start] postgresql did not become ready" >&2
  exit 1
fi

sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'bklite') THEN CREATE ROLE bklite LOGIN PASSWORD 'bklite' SUPERUSER; END IF; END \$\$;"
if ! sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='bklite'" | grep -q 1; then
  sudo -u postgres createdb -O bklite bklite
fi

echo "[start] migrate"
cd "${ROOT}/server"
uv run python manage.py migrate --noinput
if ! uv run python manage.py createcachetable django_cache; then
  echo "[start] createcachetable returned non-zero; continuing when django_cache already exists"
fi
uv run python manage.py batch_init --apps system_mgmt

wait_for_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local attempt
  for attempt in $(seq 1 90); do
    if curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/" ; then
      echo "[start] ${label} is accepting connections on ${port}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "[start] ${label} did not accept connections on ${port}" >&2
  return 1
}

echo "[start] api"
if ! curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:8011/"; then
  tmux kill-session -t bklite-api 2>/dev/null || true
  tmux new-session -d -s bklite-api -c "${ROOT}/server" -- \
    bash -lc 'exec uv run uvicorn asgi:application --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8011 --reload --workers 1'
fi

echo "[start] web"
if ! curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/"; then
  tmux kill-session -t bklite-web 2>/dev/null || true
  tmux new-session -d -s bklite-web -c "${ROOT}/web" -- \
    bash -lc 'exec pnpm dev'
fi

wait_for_port 8011 "api"
wait_for_port 3000 "web"
echo "[start] done"
